intent_en: To explain the visual encoding of a bubble chart, clarifying that bubble size represents the magnitude of debt owed by households.
previous_intent: To explain that the size of the bubbles indicates the amount of debt owed by households.

chart_support: Bubble chart legend showing three circles of increasing size labeled with debt amounts, illustrating that larger bubbles correspond to higher debt.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly defines the bubble size encoding ('bigger the bubble, the more they owe'), and the chart visualizes this with three bubbles of different sizes labeled with debt figures to serve as a legend.
